def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Return plugin(path) with fs confined to the directory `notes`.

    `path` is relative to `notes`. Every path the plugin gives `fs` is
    resolved below `notes`; anything that escapes it (`..`, absolute paths,
    symlinks out) fails to read, so the plugin sees "".
    """
    post "|" in out
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return plugin(path)
